title: Auto Heist ESP Silent Aim  Vehicle Mods
features:
The most complete hub script for Emergency Hamburg — packed with automation, combat, ESP, vehicle control, and quality-of-life features. Actively maintained, with all reported bugs patched ASAP.

Work & Heists

Auto heist (safe, bank, docks), auto sell, new server after sell, bus & truck auto, timing & safety systems

Combat

Silent aim, camera aim, trigger aim, FOV rings, team & wall checks, skip knocked players

Full auto, no recoil, reload & refill, ADS FOV, crosshair, gun sound toggle

ESP

Tag filters: name, team, wanted level, tool, staff — plus FOV ring & crosshair overlay

Vehicles

Car fly, burst speed, no speed limit, wall stop, tough car, tank mode, upgrades

Jump, get/fix/bring/copy car, paint, wheels, body, plate, sound customization

Police Tools

Speed gun, taser, grab wanted, spikes, cuff, search, slip cuffs, flashes, speed cams

Teleports

Smooth travel, saved spots, HQ teleport, bring car, seller, smuggler, snacks, radar

World & Visuals

Fullbright, fog off, no rays/blur, night mode, X-Ray, cam FOV, 3rd person FOV

Movement

Speed, jump, dash, fly, noclip, click TP, delete, anti void/lava/fall/taser, headless, spin

Performance

FPS & GPU boost, anti-lag, black screen, hide map, shader toggles

Server Tools

Anti-AFK, time display, FPS/ping/player count, auto rejoin, save spot, kick rejoin

Empty/hop/skip server, streamer mode, TP to player, anti-public

Fun

Animations, fake cuff, fake dead, custom ID, freecam, self revive

How to Use

Copy the script from the Script tab

Open your executor

Paste and execute
